title: bug: the VS Code extension reads .moe/daemon.json with no size cap
description:
Objective: bound every .moe/daemon.json read in moe-vscode. Each of these call sites reads the whole file with fs.readFileSync:
- src/services/MoeDaemonClient.ts: the connection lookup (~:604);
- src/services/MoeDaemonClient.ts: the wait-for-daemon loop (~:792), which re-reads the file until a timeout;
- src/extension.ts: the status quick-pick (~:196).
This is a sibling of task-4f1e37f30ee548298b26e17c0b6ea84e (the JetBrains reader, 64 KiB cap). daemon.json is repository content.

Deliverable:
- One small helper that reads at most 65537 bytes, used by every daemon.json read.
- At each call site, a file over 64 KiB (65536 bytes) is handled like an unparseable one.
- Valid files behave as today.

Not in scope: JetBrains (task-4f1e37f3), connection and retry behaviour, and the other clients, which have their own sibling tasks.

Verification: cd moe-vscode && npm test && npm run compile.
definitionOfDone: Every daemon.json read in MoeDaemonClient.ts and extension.ts goes through one helper that reads at most 65537 bytes; a grep finds no other readFileSync of daemon.json in moe-vscode/src.
A node:test case proves the helper accepts a valid 65536-byte daemon.json, treats a 65537-byte one as unreadable, and refuses a sparse multi-GiB file promptly.
Fresh cd moe-vscode && npm test && npm run compile exits 0.

implementationPlan.note: Gate in snapshot /tmp/moe-e57d-gate.GrZh29 (base bbd614a, 3 owned files overlaid + cmp'd): npm test 165/165 pass, compile exit 0.

Self-review of the 3-file diff found nothing to change, so the step 3 gate stands. Checks: cap off-by-one (65536 ok, 65537 refused); short reads looped; fd closed in finally; only the two config.json readFileSync calls remain in src; the error text has no file content; no existing harness edited. Residuals (pre-existing): ensureDaemonRunning restarts the daemon on any unreadable daemon.json; opening a FIFO would block.

reopenReason: Human asked the architect seat to promote and plan the daemon.json size-cap follow-ups (2026-10-27).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) A new src/util module for the helper: rejected. Four vm harnesses transpile MoeDaemonClient.ts with a require stub that resolves unknown names from tests/, so a new relative import would break them all, or force edits to four more test files. Exporting the helper from MoeDaemonClient.ts keeps the harnesses untouched; extension.ts already imports from it. (2) A helper that returns null and adds per-site null branches: rejected. Throwing reuses each site's existing catch, which already defines what 'unparseable' means at that site, so each site changes one token. (3) A size pre-check: rejected. Lying metadata. (4) A /dev/zero case: rejected. Runaway memory against unbounded code.
planningNotes.risks:
- Do not run compile, npm ci or npm install in the shared checkout: compile overwrites the gitignored dist bundle.
- The new vm context must pass Buffer.
- The sparse 3 GiB fixture needs about 3 GiB of free temp space on NTFS, though it writes no bytes.
- The cap is a cross-package contract: do not change 64 KiB here.
- The plan files of task-6f3725e6 [CQ-I04] (REVIEW) are disjoint (PlanReviewPanel.ts and the tests).

completionSummary: Added readDaemonJsonText (exported from MoeDaemonClient.ts): one fd, reads at most 65537 bytes in a short-read loop, throws 'daemon.json is larger than 64 KiB' over the cap, closes the fd in finally. All four daemon.json reads now use it: getDaemonInfo, ensureDaemonRunning, waitForDaemonInfo, and the extension.ts status quick-pick. Each site's existing catch treats an oversize file as unparseable, and an oversize file is never unlinked. New tests/daemon-json-cap.test.cjs covers a 65536-byte file accepted, 65537 refused, a sparse 3 GiB file refused promptly with exactly 65537 bytes read and one fd opened and closed, a read error still closing the fd, and a static check that no daemon.json readFileSync remains. Verified in an isolated snapshot (base bbd614a, 3 owned files overlaid): npm test 165/165, compile exit 0. The shared checkout's moe-vscode was never built.
